items.summary: CrowdStrike agreed to acquire Zscaler in an all-stock transaction valuing the company at approximately $43.9 billion. Zscaler shareholders will receive 1.135 shares of CrowdStrike common stock for each Zscaler share, representing a 34% premium to Zscaler's closing price on November 20, 2026. The transaction is expected to close in the second half of CrowdStrike's fiscal year 2028, subject to Zscaler shareholder approval and regulatory clearance.
items.title: CrowdStrike to acquire Zscaler for approximately $43.9 billion in all-stock deal

items.summary: Nvidia's Board of Directors voted unanimously on November 22, 2026, to reinstate Jensen Huang as President, Chief Executive Officer and Board member effective immediately. The Board said it was satisfied with Huang's candor and ability to lead, received input from senior U.S. government officials, and determined his reinstatement poses no national security risk. Colette Kress continues as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer.
items.title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as President and CEO

items.summary: Prudential Financial's Board of Directors elected Jay Wintrob as an independent director effective January 1, 2027. Wintrob will serve on the Finance Committee and Investment Committee and brings over 40 years of leadership and financial services expertise, most recently as chief executive officer of Oaktree Capital Management.
items.title: Prudential Financial elects Jay Wintrob as independent director

items.summary: PNC Financial Services Group expanded its board to 14 directors and elected Mark Wiedman, who has served as President since May 2025, as a director. The Board also approved a $20 million performance restricted share unit award to Wiedman, vesting over five years based on the company's total shareholder return relative to peers and subject to capital ratio tests.
items.title: PNC Financial Services elects President Mark Wiedman to board of directors

items.summary: American Tower Corporation announced a proposed settlement of litigation against DISH Wireless and EchoStar under which the company expects to receive $525 million in cash on or before December 31, 2026, from an FCC Trust established for spectrum sale transactions. The settlement is subject to execution of a definitive agreement, Bankruptcy Court approval and modification of FCC Trust procedures. The company said it would use settlement proceeds for general corporate purposes including debt reduction, share repurchases and potential mergers and acquisitions.
items.title: American Tower reaches proposed $525 million settlement with DISH and EchoStar

items.summary: Strategy Inc sold 1.9 million shares of Class A common stock for $176.7 million in net proceeds during the week ended November 22, 2026. The company used $29.6 million of those proceeds to purchase 457 bitcoin at an average price of $64,898 each, bringing total holdings to 851,305 bitcoin. The board also approved a $1 billion increase in its digital credit securities repurchase program authorization, to $4.0 billion.
items.title: Strategy Inc sold shares and bought bitcoin in latest ATM update

items.summary: Zscaler reported first-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of $949.3 million, up 20% from $788.1 million a year earlier, with annual recurring revenue growing 21% to $3,882 million. The company announced it has entered into a definitive agreement to be acquired by CrowdStrike and said it will not hold a conference call or provide forward guidance due to the transaction.
items.title: Zscaler posts 20% revenue growth and enters CrowdStrike acquisition deal

items.summary: DoorDash increased its revolving credit facility by $1.5 billion to $3.5 billion total on November 23, 2026. The company also entered into a $1.792 billion delayed draw term loan facility to finance its pending acquisition of Instacart, with the option to increase commitments up to $2.0 billion subject to lender agreement.
items.title: DoorDash upsizes revolving credit facility and enters term loan agreement for Instacart acquisition

items.summary: CrowdStrike has agreed to acquire Zscaler in an all-stock transaction valued at approximately $43.9 billion, with Zscaler shareholders receiving 1.135 CrowdStrike shares for each Zscaler share owned, representing a 34% premium to Zscaler's closing price on November 20, 2026. The combined company is expected to have more than $10 billion in annual recurring revenue at closing, with CrowdStrike projecting approximately $1 billion in annualized run-rate revenue synergies within 30 months and $500 million in cost synergies within 18 to 24 months. The transaction is expected to close in the second half of CrowdStrike's fiscal year 2028, subject to Zscaler shareholder approval and regulatory clearance.
items.title: CrowdStrike to acquire Zscaler for approximately $43.9 billion in all-stock deal

items.summary: CrowdStrike reported record third-quarter fiscal 2027 results with total revenue of $1.58B, up 28% year-over-year, and net new ARR of $419M, with ending ARR reaching $6.26B, up 27% year-over-year. The company announced a definitive agreement to acquire Zscaler in an all-stock transaction valued at approximately $43.9B, with Zscaler shareholders receiving 1.135 CrowdStrike shares per Zscaler share. CrowdStrike also raised its full-year FY27 guidance for net new ARR growth by 1,060 basis points to 45% year-over-year growth at the midpoint.
items.title: CrowdStrike reports record Q3 results and agrees to acquire Zscaler for $43.9B

items.summary: Brookfield Asset Management has agreed to acquire PGP Glass, a global specialty glass packaging manufacturer, from Blackstone-managed funds for $1.7 billion. The acquisition will be funded through Brookfield Capital Partners and Brookfield Business Corporation, with closing expected in Q1 2027 pending customary regulatory approvals. PGP Glass serves cosmetics, pharmaceutical and food and beverage industries across more than 70 countries from manufacturing facilities in India and Sri Lanka.
items.title: Brookfield to acquire PGP Glass from Blackstone for $1.7 billion

items.summary: The Illinois Commerce Commission approved base rate increases for WEC Energy's utility subsidiaries: $40.4 million (4.1%) for Peoples Gas Light and Coke Company and $1.9 million (1.8%) for North Shore Gas Company, effective no later than December 18, 2026. The ICC approved a 9.48% authorized return on equity and disallowed $44.82 million of PGL's 2026 forecasted capital costs related to its Pipeline Replacement Program, though WEC said it does not anticipate an impairment charge other than approximately $1.7 million.
items.title: WEC Energy subsidiaries receive $42.3 million base rate increase from Illinois regulator

items.summary: Energy Transfer LP completed an underwritten public offering of $2.7B in senior notes across three tranches on November 20, 2026: $900M of 5.450% notes due 2032, $900M of 5.900% notes due 2037, and $900M of 6.550% notes due 2057. The notes were issued under a supplemental indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company, National Association, as trustee.
items.title: Energy Transfer LP completes $2.7B senior notes offering in three tranches

items.summary: George A. Scangos, Ph.D., a member of Agilent Technologies' Board of Directors, notified the company on November 16, 2026, of his decision to retire from the Board effective December 1, 2026. The Board decided to reduce its size from 11 to 10 members following Dr. Scangos's retirement. The company stated his departure was not due to any disagreement with the Company or the Board.
items.title: Agilent Technologies director George Scangos retires from board

items.summary: Baker Hughes completed its acquisition of Chart Industries on July 16, 2026 for $210.00 per share in cash, pursuant to an Agreement and Plan of Merger dated July 28, 2025. Chart Industries reported net income of $1.0M for the six months ended June 30, 2026 compared to $125.6M for the same period in 2025, with sales of $1,870.4M versus $2,083.8M year over year. Baker Hughes funded a $266.0M termination fee to Flowserve Corporation for Chart's previously announced merger with that company.
items.title: Baker Hughes completes Chart Industries acquisition on July 16, 2026

items.summary: The Federal Reserve announced that UCLA won the 23rd annual College Fed Challenge, a competition in which undergraduate students analyze economic conditions and formulate monetary policy recommendations. The competition included 141 schools from 34 states, the most in its history.
items.title: Federal Reserve announces College Fed Challenge winners

items.summary: The Federal Reserve Board released results from a survey of senior financial officers at banks conducted between September 18 and September 28, 2026, in collaboration with the Federal Reserve Bank of New York. The survey included responses from banks holding approximately three-fourths of total banking system reserve balances and gathered information about banks' reserve balance management strategies, balance sheet expectations, deposit balances, money market activity, and views on operations during weekends and holidays.
items.title: Federal Reserve releases Senior Financial Officer Survey on reserve balance management
